description: NaY(Te₂O₅)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/nbc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and four longer (2.41 Å) Y-O bond lengths. Te is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.52 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Y and two equivalent Te atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Te atoms.
